title: Sales & CS Launch Toolkit: Cheat Sheets, Live Demo Scripts, and Release-Note Runbook
creator: Morgan Chen
description: Create a compact, consumable toolkit for Sales and Customer Success to support the console-2026.03 launch. Deliverables: 1) one-page cheat sheets per persona (Platform Engineer, ML Engineer, Product Manager) that map customer needs to talking points, pricing signals, and demo prompts; 2) live demo scripts with branching flows for 10-, 20-, and 35-minute meetings; 3) FAQ and objection-handling matrix; 4) release-note runbook that coordinates messaging across Product, Docs, Marketing, and Support for day-of and post-launch communications. This ticket coordinates cross-functional inputs, final approvals, and handoff artifacts to enable GTM teams to start outreach on day 1.
deliverables: Persona cheat sheets: Platform Engineer / ML Engineer / Product Manager
Battlecard-lite: value props, competitive differentiators, pricing cues
Live demo scripts: 10m (overview), 20m (deep-dive), 35m (technical workshop) with alternate flows
Objection handling matrix and short responses for Sales to memorize
Release-note runbook: timeline, owner map, approved copy snippets for docs/marketing/support
Recordable demo checklist and sample prompts for Redwood API/Private/Dedicated flows
acceptance_criteria: All cheat sheets reviewed and approved by Product and Design
Demo scripts exercised in at least two dry runs with Sales and CS and adjusted based on feedback
Release-note runbook has named owners for each channel and a published schedule
Legal has approved all customer-facing claims in the FAQ
Assets uploaded to shared Drive with versioned filenames and accessible links included in ticket
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Engineering performance numbers change before launch -> Mitigation: include 'last-validated' timestamp and fallback wording in battlecards
Risk: Sales asks for bespoke slides for big customers -> Mitigation: provide modular slide blocks and a short customization guide
Risk: Conflicting messaging across channels -> Mitigation: gate all external copy through release-note runbook approvals
